developmental_stage: inferred: Only healthy-looking specimens were used.
material_type: Riftia specimens were dissected onboard, and samples from four different organs (here referred to as tissues) were stored at –80°C: the lamellae of the tentacular crown were shaved off to provide plume samples, trophosome samples were dissected from whole trophosome, body wall samples were retrieved and washed after removal of the trophosome, and vestimental samples were cut off from the lateral portions of the vestimentum.

cell_type.evidence: inferred: trophosome samples were dissected from whole trophosome

sample_source.evidence: Riftia samples were obtained during several research cruises in 2008, 2014, and 2017, with RV Atlantis, to the deep-sea hydrothermal vent fields on the East Pacific Rise at 9°50′N, 104°17′W.

species.evidence: we studied the deep-sea Riftia pachyptila symbiosis, a model association in which the tubeworm host is associated with only one phylotype of endosymbiotic bacteria and completely depends on this sulfur-oxidizing symbiont for nutrition.

tissue.evidence: trophosome samples were dissected from whole trophosome
